第17章 先杀叶凡再杀聂霖（第1页）
“这么说，你承认自己杀了我弟古方了！”
古轶闻言眼睛微微眯起，闪烁出森然杀意。
叶凡闻言顿时瞪大了眼睛，连忙摆手道，“可别乱给我扣帽子，冤枉好人啊……你哪只眼睛看到我杀古方了？”
古轶扭头，斜睨着趴在地上的女子冷声令道。
女子不敢有丝毫隐瞒，颤颤巍巍道，“当时，我亲眼看到他跟古方打起来了……看到古方不敌他，这才跑的……”
古轶脸色阴沉如墨，目光再度转向叶凡。
似乎，是要叶凡就此事作出合理的解释。
叶凡两手一摊，一脸无辜道，“我是跟古方发生了些肢体冲突，可我没杀他呀？当时就踹了他一脚，不至于后劲这么足，给踹死了吧？我看古方身子骨挺硬朗的，不至于。”
叶凡忽然间意识到了什么，“你确定是被一剑封喉，不是被一刀封喉？”
古轶听叶凡话里有话，眉头微微锁起。
叶凡眼眸闪烁，干脆说出了自己的猜测，“杀你弟的人不是我，应该是聂霖。”
他没对古方出剑，但现在古方死了。
毫无疑问，是有人在他走后杀了古方。
那地方，距离他跟聂霖交手之地不远。
聂霖在他走后杀古方，完全有可能。
叶凡耐心解释道，“我之前跟聂霖有过交手，后来让着家伙跑了。从交手之地离开不过三里，就碰到了古方，不小心，坏了古方好事……”

说着，其目光瞥了眼趴倒在地的女子，嘴角勾起一抹意味深长的笑意，跟着继续道，“因这事，跟古方起了些冲突，但我没杀古方。当时，聂霖肯定还在附近，应该是我走后，聂霖杀的。”
叶凡理所当然道，“这不，你还真上当了，中了他的奸计，跑这杀我给古方报仇来了。”
“你的意思，聂霖是想借我的刀，杀你？”
古轶隐约明白叶凡的意思，眸子一阵闪烁。
叶凡点头道，“聂霖这废物不是我的对手。杀不了我，但又想我死，所以才出了这么个馊主意。哎……就是可怜古方了。”
“聂霖可是灵武境八阶，居然也不是叶凡的对手？杀不了叶凡？”
“不会吧？我听说这个聂霖很厉害，有着新生第一的实力。”
“是啊！不厉害，又怎么可能刚来皇城就被沐坚导师收为亲传弟子？”
塔门前众人彼此窃窃私语，一个个对叶凡的话表示怀疑，不相信叶凡有这么强。
哪怕不久前，叶凡刚展露出碾压林清月的实力。
但林清月才灵武境六阶，聂霖是灵武境八阶。

Chapter 17 Kill Ye Fan first and then Nie Lin (page 1)
"So, you admitted that you killed my brother Gu Fang!"
When Gu Yi heard this, his eyes narrowed slightly, flashing with murderous intent.
Ye Fan's eyes widened when he heard this, and he waved his hands quickly and said, "Don't blame me randomly, and accuse a good person unjustly... Which of your eyes saw me killing Gu Fang?"
Guyi turned his head, looked sideways at the woman lying on the ground and ordered coldly.
The woman did not dare to hide anything, and said tremblingly, "At that time, I saw him and Gu Fang fighting with my own eyes... Seeing that Gu Fang was defeated by him, he ran away..."
Gu Yi's face was as gloomy as ink, and his eyes turned to Ye Fan again.
It seemed that Ye Fan was asked to give a reasonable explanation for this matter.
Ye Fan spread his hands and said with an innocent face, "I had some physical conflict with Gu Fang, but I didn't kill him? I kicked him at that time, wouldn't he be so strong that he would be kicked to death? I think Gu Fang's body is quite strong, so it's not like that."
Ye Fan suddenly realized something, "Are you sure your throat was sealed with a sword, not a knife?"
Gu Yi frowned slightly when he heard that there was something in Ye Fan's words.
Ye Fan's eyes flickered and he simply expressed his guess, "I wasn't the one who killed your brother, it was Nie Lin."
He didn't draw his sword against Gu Fang, but now Gu Fang is dead.
There is no doubt that someone killed Gu Fang after he left.
That place was not far from where he and Nie Lin fought.
It is entirely possible for Nie Lin to kill Gu Fang after he leaves.
Ye Fan explained patiently, "I had a fight with Nie Lin before, and then I let him run away. I was only three miles away from the place where we fought, and I ran into Gu Fang. I accidentally ruined Gu Fang's good deeds..."
As he said that, he glanced at the woman lying on the ground, raised a meaningful smile at the corner of his mouth, and continued, "Because of this matter, I had some conflicts with Gu Fang, but I did not kill Gu Fang. Nie Lin must have been still nearby at that time, and Nie Lin should have killed him after I left."
Ye Fan said matter-of-factly, "No, you were really fooled and fell into his trick. You came here to kill me to avenge Gu Fang."
"You mean, Nie Lin wants to borrow my knife to kill you?"
Gu Yi vaguely understood what Ye Fan meant, and his eyes flickered.
Ye Fan nodded and said, "Nie Lin, this loser, is no match for me. He can't kill me, but he wants me dead, so he came up with such a bad idea. Alas... I just pity Gu Fang."
"Nie Lin is at the eighth level of the Spiritual Martial Realm, but he is not Ye Fan's opponent? Can't he kill Ye Fan?"
"No way? I heard that Nie Lin is very powerful and has the ability to be the number one among the freshmen."
"Yes! If you are not very powerful, how could you be accepted as a direct disciple by Master Mu Jian when you first came to the Imperial City?"
Everyone in front of the tower gate whispered to each other, and everyone expressed doubts about Ye Fan's words, not believing that Ye Fan was so strong.
Even not long ago, Ye Fan just showed his strength to crush Lin Qingyue.
But Lin Qingyue was only at the sixth level of the Lingwu Realm, and Nie Lin was at the eighth level of the Lingwu Realm.
